description: This file defines the 'CleanCacheCommands' class used for cleaning cache directories within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods to identify and delete various cache subdirectories, facilitating cache management operations.

classes.name: CleanCacheCommands
classes.description: A class extending Robo Tasks to implement cache cleaning commands specific to SuiteCRM, notably cleaning various cache directories.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Main method to clean specified cache directories within the SuiteCRM cache folder, with optional force parameter to skip confirmation.
